name: Advanced Excel
overview: The Advanced Excel course is designed to help learners master Microsoft Excel for office work, reporting, data analysis, and business productivity.
description: This course provides practical training in Advanced Microsoft Excel with industry-relevant features used in offices, businesses, and corporate environments.
eligibility: Open to anyone interested in learning Microsoft Excel.

duration.note: Course duration varies. Please contact the academy for details.

fees.note: Please contact the academy for the latest fee details.

teaching_methodology: Personalized teaching with practical assignments and individual attention.
study_material: Comprehensive study material is provided according to the course requirements.
faculty: Highly qualified and experienced faculty members.

faqs.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Basic computer knowledge is recommended before joining Advanced Excel.

faqs.question: Will I learn Pivot Tables?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts are included in the course.

faqs.question: Does the course include formulas and functions?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course covers formulas along with mathematical, logical, text, date/time, and lookup functions.

faqs.question: Will I learn charts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Different types of charts are covered.

faqs.question: Is Conditional Formatting included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Conditional Formatting is part of the syllabus.

faqs.question: Does the course include dashboard creation?
Is practical training provided?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course focuses on practical Excel exercises and real-world applications.

faqs.question: Do you provide study material?
faqs.answer: Yes. Comprehensive study material is provided.

faqs.question: How can I know the course duration and fees?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy for the latest duration and fee details.
